title: Managing API Keys in Zero Trust Branch

blocks.text: To integrate Zero Trust Branch with other applications using the Zero Trust Branch APIs, you must create a unique API key and then copy it into the other applications. You can view a list of keys you have created, but you can only view and copy the key itself once.
To add an API key, follow these steps:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > API > Zero Trust Branch API Keys. Click Settings in the API Keys drawer and select Add API Key from the drop-down menu.
In the Add API Key drawer, enter a descriptive name and click Add API Key.
The API key displays. Click the Copy icon to copy and save the API key. You need this key to complete your integration.
After you close the Add API Key drawer, you are no longer able to view or copy the key.

blocks.text: You can view a list of the API keys you have created and revoke them to sever the integration with the external application.
To view and revoke API keys, follow these steps:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > API > Zero Trust Branch API Keys. Click Settings in the API Keys panel and select View API Keys from the drop-down menu.
In the API Keys drawer, you can view API keys you have created along with their creation dates. Note that the key itself can only be viewed when it is first created.
To revoke an API key, click the Revoke (trash can) icon. The key is deleted and any integrations using that key for authentication will no longer work.
